description: What every network call the desktop makes is for. importance: 1 cosmetic .. 10 the app does not work without it. modestPerHour: a reasonable ceiling while the app is open (connections per hour for sockets). requestNeeded: 0..100, how likely it truly has to be a request rather than a websocket push, an event or a refresh. alternative: the push, event or refresh path that could replace it. source: where the call is made, repo-relative "path: Class::function", shown in the firewall prompt. Patterns use firewall rule syntax; the most specific matching pattern wins and a named method beats none. Hosts that cannot be named (Mastodon instances, custom Solana RPCs, mirror DNS names outside forkmesh.com) are not listed.
